decisions_on_author_doubts.1_domains: Domain follows the situation and the candidate's role. sportabonnement keeps educatie (student role, school discount, fellow student, distance to school); eerste-schooldag becomes overig (a child's school day narrated by an adult; blueprint section 9 and 016 medicijn-school); trein-gemist stays werk. Counts become werk 3, educatie 2, overig 3; the next B1 speaking batch should add an educatie middellang task.
decisions_on_author_doubts.2_glasbak_neighbourhood: Accepted: the content is a waste rule, a fine and a report to the gemeente (instanties); no change.
decisions_on_author_doubts.3_two_narration_tenses: Accepted; tense consistency moves to the feedback rubric under sentence formation.
decisions_on_author_doubts.4_five_criteria: Too many and the fifth is a form criterion: delete it; four content criteria remain.
decisions_on_author_doubts.5_language_shape_criteria: Dropped or converted: trein-gemist criterion 4 becomes the feelings criterion (with one clause added to the prompt), eerste-schooldag criterion 5 is deleted, machinestoring criterion 3 keeps order and instruct-not-describe (content in the official scale) and loses the connector-word list. Tense and connector checks belong to the b1-spreken feedback.
decisions_on_author_doubts.6_cursusverzoek_register: Keep the manager's je and the candidate's u; the feedback must accept an answer in je.
decisions_on_author_doubts.7_machinestoring_callee: Keep it open; no prompt change.
decisions_on_author_doubts.8_tables: fietskeuze balanced; sportabonnement leans to Zuid, acceptable since validity is not judged; an optional opening-hours swap gives De Brug a second advantage.
decisions_on_author_doubts.10_invented_details: Acceptable; not required of learners; dropping 'het nummer hangt bij de telefoon' is optional.
decisions_on_author_doubts.11_sibling_016: No repeated setting; keep koffiemachine and machinestoring, and the exam-themed tasks, apart in drills.
decisions_on_author_doubts.coordinator_tables_15s: Readable: 28 and 39 words, mostly numbers, and the app keeps the table on screen while speaking; the five-row table is at the limit.
decisions_on_author_doubts.coordinator_model_length: 65-69 words fit 30 seconds for a fluent speaker (25-29 s at 3.5 syllables per second) and are the ceiling for a B1 learner (32-34 s at 3.0); accepted within the blueprint; 60-65 suggested as the target for later batches.
decisions_on_author_doubts.coordinator_je_vs_u: Right as it is; asymmetric address is realistic and the candidate's register is consistent.

Tables as a Spreken I stimulus are allowed by blueprint section 4.9 but the research paragraph records only cues and pictures for the official Deel 2; the level-check reviewer should judge the exam likeness of fietskeuze and sportabonnement.
diversity_review: Eight distinct settings and six speech-act shapes across pictures, tables and cue-only stimuli, both registers, three domains; no slug reuse and no re-skin of a catalogue item; only the fixed exam instructions mirror the official format; none of the seven B1 speaking settings of blueprint section 9 or the 009 topics recur.
